basis.interpretation: The project owner granted authority on 13 September 2026 to design a pending-activation restart ceremony as a proposal to be approved before implementation, and approved the proposal as written the same day. This amendment adds one human-confirmed tool and two events; it preserves D2-013 (ten-minute one-use code, fresh issuer confirmation before any grant), the challenge state machine (the stale challenge ends revoked; the fresh code is a new linked object) and the active-only replacement-passkey recovery policy. It grants no role, seat, scope or activation by itself.

tools.name: reissue_activation
tools.requiredAuthority: company admin + `S:A`; current board secretary + `S:A` for a pending seat on their own board. The first setup administrator's own pending activation is served only by the operator CLI mode `bootstrap reissue-first-activation`.
tools.objectRule: Exactly one same-organization member in `pending_activation` with an active registered passkey whose latest activation challenge is expired or exhausted and never consumed; not the caller; no live (issued, unexpired, unexhausted) challenge; the consumed invitation stays consumed. Issues a one-use ten-minute restart handoff; the fresh ten-minute code is minted only after a user-verified assertion with the already-registered passkey.
tools.requiredEvidence: Protected confirmation naming the member, the stale challenge and the proofing method; `activation_restart_issued` linking the revoked challenge and the handoff; `activation_restart_completed` linking the handoff and the fresh challenge; the later `confirm_enrollment_activation` binds that fresh challenge. Append-only history.
